headline: Genesys Xperience 2026: Winning in the Agentic Era Starts Here
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 28, 2026--Genesys®, a global cloud leader in AI-Powered Experience Orchestration, today announced Xperience 2026, the premier customer experience (CX) and AI event of the year, taking place Sept. 1 - 3, 2026 at the Wynn Las Vegas Resort.
